query: 供应商环境标准 供应商环境标准 衡量供应链环境准入标准与约束机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备系统的供应商环境准入标准（含碳足迹、排污等硬性指标）；实行动态环境分级管理，并根据分级结果执行差异化采购政策；有明确的违规处理机制（如红线淘汰制）。 • 1分（合格）：发布了供应商行为准则，包含基础的环境保护要求，具备初次准入的环境审核，但缺乏动态分级管理或明确的违规退出机制。 • 0分（不合格）：无供应商环境标准披露，或仅笼统提及“推行绿色采购”。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：已签署环境协议或执行环境标准的供应商数量（或采购额）占比 >80%。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对一级供应商/关键原材料供应商执行，或未披露具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 供应商环境标准 绿色采购 供应商行为准则 环境准入 供应商环境审核 分级管理 环境黑名单 供应商退出机制 supplier environmental standards green procurement supplier code of conduct environmental prequalification supplier environmental audit tiered supplier management environmental blacklist supplier exit mechanism 企业是否制定供应商环境准入标准？ 标准是否包含碳足迹、排污等硬性要求？ 是否实行动态环境分级管理与差异化采购？ 违规处理或红线淘汰机制是什么？ 已签署/执行标准的供应商数量或采购额占比是多少？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '供应商环境标准'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否制定供应商环境准入标准？ 标准是否包含碳足迹、排污等硬性要求？ 是否实行动态环境分级管理与差异化采购？ 违规处理或红线淘汰机制是什么？ 已签署/执行标准的供应商数量或采购额占比是多少？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“绿色采购”；仅有企业自身环境政策；仅有供应商劳工准则而无环境条款；仅有一次性供应商培训活动；区分：本指标聚焦供应链环境准入与约束；供应商行为准则可能同时含劳工与环境，需抽出环境条款；企业环境政策不等于已对供应商设硬性标准；道德采购更偏人权/合规采购。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE OPERATION / Mutual success with suppliers
results.text: Ju Teng International clarifies the cooperation, communication, and management model with suppliers and potential suppliers at all stages through the 'Supplier Management Procedure'. Through effective management of suppliers, Ju Teng International understands suppliers' quality, price, delivery, coordination, labour, environmental protection, safety, ethics and other relevant information, and follows up and deals with supplier problems in a timely manner. For different types of suppliers, Ju Teng International has different management processes in order to manage them in a more targeted manner. For example, for the management of non-enclosure suppliers, Ju Teng International revised the relevant management requirements (on-site audit, production part approval process (PPAP) submission, quality technical agreement terms, etc.). After an abnormal problem occurs, the 8D or applicable problem solving procedures are initiated so that the abnormal problem can be solved in a timely and thorough manner.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITY FOR ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION
results.text: Ju Teng International strictly complies with various environmental laws and regulations. On top of that, we established the internal management policies such as the 'Administrative Provisions of Environmental Protection', the 'Accountability System on Environmental Protection', the 'Management of Environmental Incidents' and the 'Environmental Factors and Hazardous Source Management Procedures' to manage possible negative environmental impacts in the production, maintenance, and service process in each Production Plant. All Production Plants of Ju Teng Group have obtained the ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems Certification and IECQ HSPM 080000 Hazardous Substance Process Management Systems Certification.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE OPERATION / Mutual success with suppliers
results.text: Ju Teng International formulated the 'Environment-Related Substance Reduction Plan Form', which imposes strict requirements on the suppliers to ban the use of heavy metals, formaldehyde, ozone hazardous substances, radioactive substances and so on. In order to restrict suppliers from using prohibited materials or chemical substances in the production process and on the products, parts and packaging materials provided to Ju Teng International, Ju Teng International has signed the 'Environmental Protection Agreement' with suppliers. In addition, Ju Teng International performs due diligence on the source and chain of custody of the purchased minerals, and requires the suppliers to complete and sign the 'Metal Mineral Origin Survey Form' and the 'Commitment on the Non-use of Conflict Minerals' so that no conflict minerals are used in the production process and on the products. That is, whenever reasonably possible, the products manufactured do not contain minerals such as gold, tantalum, tin and tungsten from armed groups abusing human rights in the Democratic Republic of the Congo or its neighbouring countries/regions.

In order to restrict suppliers from using prohibited materials or chemical substances in the production process and on the products, parts and packaging materials provided to Ju Teng International, Ju Teng International has signed the 'Environmental Protection Agreement' with suppliers. In addition, Ju Teng International performs due diligence on the source and chain of custody of the purchased minerals, and requires the suppliers to complete and sign the 'Metal Mineral Origin Survey Form' and the 'Commitment on the Non-use of Conflict Minerals' so that no conflict minerals are used in the production process and on the products. That is, whenever reasonably possible, the products manufactured do not contain minerals such as gold, tantalum, tin and tungsten from armed groups abusing human rights in the Democratic Republic of the Congo or its neighbouring countries/regions.

results.text: The Group found that the qualification of outsourced supplier is weak while their quality is unstable. There is negligence in the work to promote the improvement of quality abnormality, and the outsourced suppliers fail to conduct continuous tracking to confirm the improvement effect after significant anomalies. results.text: In accordance with the 'Energy Conservation Law of the People's Republic of China' and other national and local laws and regulations in the region where we operate, Ju Teng International established and implemented the 'Energy and Resource Management Procedures', which outlines the roles and responsibilities of relevant departments in energy and resource management alongside offering detailed operational rules for energy and resource consumption in the production and operation process. Ju Teng International encourages all Production Plants to manage their targets according to their actual production and operation conditions. By setting specific targets on electricity, water, gas, and energy consumptions, the efficiency on use of natural resources is greatly increased, hence, minimising the negative environmental impacts brought by the Group.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITY FOR ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION / Energy management
results.text: Purchased electricity, natural gas and diesel are the main types of energy consumed by Ju Teng International in the course of production and operation. Ju Teng International has systematically strengthened the management of energy use through the 'Energy and Resource Management Procedure'. By adopting environmentally and socially friendly measures which are technically feasible and economically viable, we have actively updated our internal management regulations on energy use and mobilised all employees to save energy and reduce consumption. During the Reporting Period, the Compal Production Plant has adopted scientific methods to formulate production quota assessment and fully motivate the staff to save energy and reduce consumption through the combination of assessment and reward and punishment system. According to the load change and operation condition of the equipment, the characteristics of frequency conversion control technology are used to carry out energy-saving technical transformation of some equipment running at low load, which has achieved a power saving rate of about 30%. Meanwhile, all plants adopt green lighting to reduce energy consumption.

Meanwhile, all plants adopt green lighting to reduce energy consumption.

results.text: During the Reporting Period, with the support and cooperation of the energy working group, all departments of the Compal Production Plant have mobilised employees at all levels to participate in discussions on production energy use analysis. Starting from various aspects that affect energy consumption, such as personnel, machinery and equipment, material use, and process methods, and combining the process flow of production operations and the Company's 'Energy and Resource Management Procedure', these departments have conducted a comprehensive analysis of the energy utilisation and consumption data and equipment operation records for the year 2021. Besides, the Compal Production Plant has sorted out the energy use of the plants and strengthened the energy consumption management of all plants in accordance with the energy efficiency limit standards of various types of equipment, the economic operation standards of various types of equipment, the design parameters of various types of energy-consuming equipment, and the advanced energy consumption level of the industry, etc.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITY FOR ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION
results.text: Ju Teng International always encourages each Production Plant to fully utilise its own advantages and resources to develop and build new energy projects such as photovoltaic power generation. During the Reporting Period, the Compal Production Plant continued to utilise the unused vacant land and roof of the plant for photovoltaic power generation. In 2021, 11,890 MWh of photovoltaic power was generated, saving 1,462 tons of coal equivalent. Clean electricity produced by photovoltaic power plants was used for the Company's production and operation, which reduces the purchased electricity and indirectly reduces the greenhouse gas emissions caused by thermal power generation, with a decrease in emission of 11,316 tons CO 2 .
